authority_boundaries.integration_mode: tools-only with automatic recall and retention disabled

cases.check: A unique synthetic identifier is returned for a direct question.
A paraphrased query retrieves the synthetic communication preference.
The corrected schedule is returned and the obsolete Tuesday 09:00 schedule is absent after an explicit correction.
An unrelated query returns no memory results.
The real Hermes hindsight_recall tool result exposes the configured synthetic source or tag.
The exact fact remains available after a daemon stop and fresh process restart.
Deleting the isolated bank makes post-delete recall empty and the prior provider remains active.

pass_rule: Every case passes, tools-only behavior is verified, and setup/restart/removal complete without a material operational failure.
